name: Dr. Roger Ramos Navarro, DMD
role: Implantology, endodontics and full mouth rehabilitation
bio: Dr. Ramos Navarro plans the complex cases: full mouth rehabilitation, dental implants and root canals. Trained in Cuba, the United States, Spain and Peru.

name: Dr. Gretell Alonso Fiel, DMD
role: Porcelain veneers, digital smile design and facial aesthetics
bio: Dr. Alonso designs smiles for the face. Trained in Madrid and at Rutgers, she combines porcelain veneers, digital smile design and facial aesthetics so the result is balanced from every angle, not just the teeth.

name: Dr. Marta Puentes Marrero, DMD
bio: Dr. Puentes has practiced in Spain, the United Kingdom and the United States. Her work is conservative by design: preserve the natural tooth, restore function, and make the result look like it was always there.
